summary: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a...
description: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into the unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page read by the BootROM. By overwriting a fuse-derived RAM variable via a crafted patch entry using Phison Vendor Specific Commands, an attacker can force CRC-only firmware verification instead of signature checking, enabling an unsigned firmware image to load and creating a persistent controller-level implant that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host operating system.

summary: In EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with...
description: In EDB Postgres Extended Server and EDB Postgres Advanced Server versions 15 through 18 with Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled, the key used to encrypt temporary files was incompletely initialized. The code applied sizeof() to a pointer to the key buffer rather than to the buffer itself, so only 8 of the intended 32 bytes were filled from a secure random source and the remaining 24 bytes kept whatever was already in memory. This reduces the guaranteed randomness of the temporary-file key from 256 bits to 64 bits. Exploiting this requires local read access to the server's temporary-file directory, and those files normally exist only while the server is running; they persist only after a crash and are removed at the next server start. Permanent data files and WAL are not affected. The issue is fixed in EDB Postgres Extended Server 15.20, 16.16, 17.12 and 18.7 and EDB Postgres Advanced Server 15.20.0, 16.16.0, 17.12.0 and 18.7.0; the server must be restarted after upgrading.

summary: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and...
description: LibreOffice checks the digital signatures of a PDF document when the document is opened, and shows whether each signature is valid. An out-of-bounds write existed when a signature was checked, because the parts of the file that a crafted signature claims to cover were not checked against the size of the file. In fixed versions a signature that claims to cover anything outside the file is reported as not valid.

summary: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features...
description: LibreOffice Base documents can hold an embedded HSQLDB database. When the experimental features option is enabled, LibreOffice offers to migrate such a database to the embedded Firebird engine when the document is opened. A heap buffer overflow existed when binary values were copied during the migration, because a value could be longer than the space set aside for its column. In fixed versions that space is enlarged whenever a value is longer than its column.

summary: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF...
description: LibreOffice Calc can open spreadsheets in the DIF format, and text files such as CSV in the UTF-16 encoding. Both are read one line at a time. An out-of-bounds read existed when a line of a crafted file was read, because the length of the line could be miscalculated, so memory beyond the line could be copied into the imported document. In fixed versions each line is read up to its limit and no further.

summary: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external...
description: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. An out-of-bounds read existed when the link target of a crafted picture was read, so memory past the picture data could end up in the converted document. In fixed versions the link target is taken only from the picture data.

summary: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls...
description: LibreOffice Writer can save documents in DOCX format. A document can contain content controls whose values are bound to custom XML data, and that data is updated with the current values when the document is exported, including in a conversion run from the command line. Values taken from the document were not escaped where they were used, so a crafted document could write a file of its choosing anywhere the user can write when it was exported to DOCX. In fixed versions these values are written into the document directly, and the XSLT transformations LibreOffice runs can no longer write files or use the network.

summary: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file...
description: LibreOffice can export documents to PDF protected by a password. With the PDF 2.0 option the file is encrypted with 256-bit AES, using a file encryption key and salts that are meant to be random. The key and the salts were drawn from a pseudo-random number generator that is not suitable for cryptography, so the encryption key of an exported PDF could be recovered without knowing the password. In fixed versions the key and the salts are drawn from the random source of the operating system.

summary: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet...
description: LibreOffice can open a web query file (.iqy), which names a web page to import into a spreadsheet, when the file is given on its command line, for example when a file manager or another program opens the file with LibreOffice. The address in such a file was used without the checks that apply to an address given on the command line directly, so a crafted file could make LibreOffice do something other than open a web page, up to running code. In fixed versions only an http or https address is taken from a web query file.

summary: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out...
description: LibreOffice can import EMF, EMF+ and WMF images, which may be embedded in documents. Several out-of-bounds reads existed in the readers for these formats, because sizes, counts and offsets taken from a crafted image were not checked against the data the image actually holds. In fixed versions these values are checked against the size of each record and the data that remains, and a record that fails the checks is not used.

summary: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the...
description: LibreOffice Calc can link a cell range to an external data source, and the link is saved in the document. A Java database driver for such a link is loaded from a class path. Opening a crafted document could still load a Java database driver from a location outside the local machine and run its code, by a route that the fix for CVE-2026-63277 did not cover. In fixed versions an entry in a Java class path has to be a file URL that names a file on the local machine.

summary: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the...
description: LibreOffice Base documents can bind macros to document events, such as opening or closing the document. The macro security setting decides whether macros that come with a document may run. Macros bound to the events of a Base document were run without the macro security setting being applied, so opening or converting a crafted database document could run a macro and, through it, any command. In fixed versions macros bound to the events of a Base document follow the macro security setting, as macros in other documents do.

summary: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing...
description: LibreOffice can open PDF files in Draw, where the PDF import converts each page into drawing objects that can be edited. Images in the PDF, including images with a transparency mask, are converted along the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when an image with a transparency mask was converted, because positions taken from a crafted image were not checked against the size of the image buffer. In fixed versions the image size is limited, and the position of each mask pixel is checked before it is written.

summary: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC...
description: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.

cwes.name: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code

summary: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts...
description: LibreOffice supports fonts embedded in documents. When a document is exported to PDF, the fonts it uses are embedded in the PDF, and a font in CFF (Compact Font Format) is converted to another font format on the way. An out-of-bounds write existed when the charstring program of a crafted font was interpreted, because some indexes and ranges taken from the font were not checked against the size of the data they refer to. In fixed versions these indexes and ranges are checked, and a font that fails the checks is not converted.

summary: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs ...
description: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows a local attacker with command execution as the ds user to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted --hash argument that is interpolated unvalidated into a GNU sed expression, where the sed e flag runs attacker-controlled commands. The packaged sudoers policy permits ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.

summary: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from...
description: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted file locations from loading linked images and other content. The option is not on by default. With the option on, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched while the document was imported. In fixed versions a linked background image is checked against the option like other linked images, and is not fetched when the option blocks it.

summary: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on...
description: LibreOffice can embed audio and video in documents. Where it plays media with GStreamer, as on Linux, the media is opened when the document is loaded, and a preview image of a video is shown in the document and in its exports, such as PDF. A crafted media file could make GStreamer read a local file and draw its text into the preview image, so that the content of the file ended up in an exported document. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63269. In fixed versions GStreamer opens only media in a short list of common, self-contained container formats.

summary: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use...
description: LibreOffice can connect to databases through JDBC drivers written in Java. A spreadsheet can use a database as the source of a pivot table, and the database document that describes the connection names the driver to use. The location the driver was loaded from was taken from the database document itself, so a crafted document could make LibreOffice load and run Java code that the document supplied when it was opened. This is a different route to the problem fixed for CVE-2026-63277. In fixed versions the driver location is taken only from the driver configuration of the user, and a pivot table whose source is a database document named by a URL connects only once the user allows links to be updated.

summary: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other...
description: libvisio is a library that reads drawings in the VSD and VSDX formats. LibreOffice and other applications use it to import such drawings. An out-of-bounds write existed when a crafted VSDX file contained a malformed path from one part of the drawing to another. In fixed versions a malformed path is handled without writing outside its data.

summary: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the...
description: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole, such as the document being opened or closed. Macros bound to these events were not taken into account by the macro security check, so they could run when the document was opened, whatever the macro security level. In fixed versions these macros follow the macro security settings like any other macro in the document.

summary: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields,...
description: LibreOffice documents in ODF format can contain form controls, such as buttons and text fields, and each control names the component that implements it. The component a control named was created even when it was not a form control, and the settings stored with the control were applied to it, so a crafted document could change the configuration of LibreOffice in a way that led to code being run. In fixed versions a control whose component is not a form control is ignored.

summary: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in...
description: Incorrect authorization in the sendForm RPC handler and Session JWT reconnect handling in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows an authenticated view-only user to export a reconstructed copy of a document, including content the viewer never displayed such as custom XML, custom document properties and field instruction text, even when download and form-filling are disabled. The attacker reconnects with a valid Session JWT while substituting an attacker-controlled callback URL, which the Session JWT does not bind, then invokes sendForm over RPC, causing DocumentServer to send the reconstructed DOCX to that URL.

summary: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is...
description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. When a value in the compiled form used an older record format, it could be read as a different type from the one the existing value held, which corrupted memory. In fixed versions the existing value is cleared before a value in the older format is read.

summary: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is...
description: LibreOffice documents can contain Basic macro libraries. A library protected by a password is stored in the document in a compiled form, which may be read when the document is loaded. An out-of-bounds write existed when the compiled form was read, because the positions of its strings were not checked against the size of the data they refer to, and a type found by name was not checked to be of the right kind. In fixed versions these positions are checked, a library that fails the check is not loaded, and a type of the wrong kind is ignored.

summary: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email...
description: On Linux and other Unix-like systems, LibreOffice can send the current document as an email attachment with File > Send > Email Document, which starts the mail client through a script bundled with LibreOffice. The script let the shell interpret the name of the document's file, so a file with a crafted name could run commands when it was sent by email. In fixed versions the script passes the file name and the other details to the mail client as plain arguments.

summary: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use...
description: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. summary: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and...
description: A document can carry its own user interface customizations, such as keyboard shortcuts, menus and toolbars, which take effect while the document is open. A command bound in these customizations could run a macro or a script even when the macro security settings did not allow the macros of the document, so a user who pressed a shortcut or chose a menu item in a crafted document could run code without any warning. In fixed versions the customizations of a document are treated like its other macro content, and the macro and script commands in them are only kept when the macros of the document are allowed.

summary: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the...
description: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the githubOauthCallback handler that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to sign victims in with the attacker's GitHub account by omitting state validation. Attackers can induce victims to visit the OAuth callback with an attacker-obtained authorization code, causing victim edits in the admin UI to be committed under the attacker's GitHub identity.

summary: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the getIsPathValid function...
description: Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the getIsPathValid function that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access sibling paths sharing a content directory name prefix. Attackers can send requests with a no-cors header to the blob, update, and tree handlers under /api/keystatic to read, create, overwrite, or delete files such as posts-evil/pwn.yaml.

cwes.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

summary: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in...
description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the updateSystem GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated administrators to execute shell commands via the package version string. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to the unvalidated version value, which is passed to child_process.exec() in yarn add or npm install commands, executing commands as the server process.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command

summary: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability...
description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to invoke privileged GraphQL mutations because the @Authorized() decorator is omitted. Attackers can call updateWebhook, createRelease, unpublishDocument and updateUser at /prime/graphql to create releases and, with a record UUID, redirect webhooks, unpublish documents, or overwrite user profiles.

summary: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability...
description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to register accounts via the createUser mutation on /prime/graphql. Because the isAuthenticated() guard has its check commented out and createAbility() hard-codes every role to admin, attackers can log in with full administrative control over content, users, webhooks and settings.

summary: Cetmix Tower through 17.0.3.0.0 and 18.0 before 18.0.4.0.1 contains an improper SSH host key...
description: Cetmix Tower through 17.0.3.0.0 and 18.0 before 18.0.4.0.1 contains an improper SSH host key verification vulnerability in SSHConnection.connect() that falls back to Paramiko's AutoAddPolicy when no host key is pinned. On-path attackers using ARP or DNS spoofing can present their own host key during Skip Host Key or Get from Host connections to capture stored SSH passwords and tamper with commands and files.

summary: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the...
description: Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the unauthenticated GET /prime/redirect route that allows remote attackers to redirect users to external sites. Attackers can craft links with a 36-character id and arbitrary url parameter on the trusted Prime host to send victims to phishing sites.

summary: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that...
description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read non-public team metadata by requesting the team join page with any invite ID. Attackers who know a team slug can obtain the serialized Team object, exposing billing email, billing status, Stripe customer ID, verified domain and support identifiers.

summary: Unrolled Secure before 1.18.0 contains an SSLRedirect bypass vulnerability in Secure.isSSL() that...
description: Unrolled Secure before 1.18.0 contains an SSLRedirect bypass vulnerability in Secure.isSSL() that trusts the client-supplied r.URL.Scheme to determine HTTPS transport. Attackers can send plaintext HTTP requests with an absolute-form https:// request-target to skip the HTTPS redirect and have application responses served unencrypted.

cwes.name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision

summary: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in...
description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in revalidatePathAction and revalidateCacheTagAction server actions in revalidate.ts. Unauthenticated attackers can use action identifiers exposed in the client bundle to send POST requests that purge cached pages and data, forcing repeated regeneration and degrading performance.

summary: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows...
description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to send users to arbitrary sites by supplying an unvalidated redirectUri parameter on the /pay/[id] payment link page. Attackers can distribute payment links with a malicious redirectUri that PayPageWidget opens via window.open after payment without noopener, enabling phishing and reverse tabnabbing of the payment page.

summary: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the...
description: thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the fetchClientSecret Next.js server action that allows unauthenticated attackers to create Stripe checkout sessions for other teams. Attackers can invoke the action with a forged Team object containing a victim's stripeCustomerId to obtain Growth plan Checkout session client secrets with attacker-influenced return URLs.

summary: Kiwi TCMS before 17.1 contains a hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows remote...
description: Kiwi TCMS before 17.1 contains a hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge signed data by using the publicly known Django SECRET_KEY in tcms/settings/common.py. Attackers can forge or tamper with signed cookie-based messages and django.core.signing payloads, weakening password-reset and session-authentication HMACs on deployments keeping the default.

summary: Weblate 2026.6 through 2026.11.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in...
description: Weblate 2026.6 through 2026.11.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in ChangeManager.last_changes() that exposes workspaces the viewer cannot view by skipping Workspace.can_view() checks site-wide. Anonymous visitors on instances with REQUIRE_LOGIN disabled and only public projects can query /changes/, /api/changes/, or RSS/CSV feeds to obtain hidden workspace names, UUIDs, actions, and timestamps.

summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.5 through 3.8.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that...
description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.5 through 3.8.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows registered users to leak server-wide GitLab or Gitea tokens via repository_url. Attackers can create a gitlab or gitea project pointing to a controlled host and request its branches to capture the operator's token and reach internal hosts.

summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows...
description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.

summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator...
description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator.generate_task_report that allows registered users to read server files and perform SSRF. Attackers can create a project whose name contains a link attachment element and download the task PDF report to retrieve local files or internal network responses.

summary: REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low...
description: REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to recover the administrator password hash by filtering User.password through the MCP QueryRecords tool. Attackers can send LK2 prefix-match filters to the /gw/mcp/sse gateway and use the returned total count as an oracle to extract the SHA-256 hash one character at a time, then log in as administrator.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Data Queries

summary: REBUILD 3.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low...
description: REBUILD 3.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to modify their own roleId through mass assignment in /app/entity/record-save and /app/entity/common-save. Attackers can submit their own User record with roleId set to the built-in administrator role, bypassing updatable=false restrictions to gain full administrator privileges.

cwes.name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

summary: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows...
description: DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve server secrets through the /api/v1/config/defaults endpoint. Attackers can send a GET request to obtain the operator's LLM provider API keys and GitHub or GitLab tokens, then abuse those services and accessible repositories.

summary: OfficeCLI 1.0.56 through 1.0.161 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the...
description: OfficeCLI 1.0.56 through 1.0.161 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the officecli watch preview that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped numbering w:color values. Attackers can craft a DOCX whose color closes the style element, then abuse the unauthenticated /api/batch endpoint to read local files and modify the watched document.

summary: REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged...
description: REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject AjQL conditions through the plan parameter of /project/tasks/list. Attackers can use priority-* plans and the returned task count as a boolean oracle to recover a task creator's SHA-256 password hash and log in as that user, including the administrator.

summary: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows...
description: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain paid attachments by reading storage URLs from the GET /v1/post endpoint. Attackers can download the paid file directly from the unauthenticated LocalOSS /oss static route, whose signed URL expired parameter is never checked.

summary: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that...
description: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by abusing #topic link wrapping in preparePost and parsePostTag. Attackers can publish posts or comments with a crafted topic containing a lone '<' and event handler to steal the PAOPAO_TOKEN JWT from localStorage and take over viewer accounts.

summary: SamWaf 1.0.128 through 1.3.25-beta.11 contains a request body inspection bypass vulnerability in...
description: SamWaf 1.0.128 through 1.3.25-beta.11 contains a request body inspection bypass vulnerability in WafEngine.ServeHTTP that skips bodies with chunked encoding or lengths of 2048 bytes or more. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send SQL injection, XSS, command injection, traversal or upload payloads chunked or padded, which reach the protected backend uninspected.

summary: REBUILD 4.3.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low...
description: REBUILD 4.3.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to obtain a SYSTEM_USER token by requesting /commons/file-preview with an arbitrary src value. Attackers can read the leaked _csrfToken from the redirect Location header and send it as X-AuthToken to access the admin center and administrative APIs.

summary: Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS...
description: Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS DeleteObject that allows authenticated users to delete arbitrary files by submitting crafted media values. Attackers can send dot-dot-slash sequences in the avatar or media content to POST /v1/user/avatar or POST /v1/post/comment, deleting server-writable files including configuration and data.

summary: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in...
description: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ClusterConfigurationController that allows authenticated users without cluster configuration permissions to list Flink cluster configurations. Attackers can query the /api/clusterConfiguration/list and listAll endpoints to retrieve full configJson deployment settings for every cluster in their tenant.

summary: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in DataSourceController...
description: Dinky through 1.2.5 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in DataSourceController.testConnect that allows any authenticated user to open arbitrary JDBC connections by supplying caller-controlled connection settings. Attackers can probe internal hosts and ports via returned driver errors, or supply a MySQL JDBC URL enabling local-infile against a malicious server to read files from the Dinky host.

summary: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 fails to validate the attachment_price field when...
description: Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 fails to validate the attachment_price field when creating posts, allowing authenticated users to set negative prices on charge attachments. Attackers with two ordinary accounts can download the attachment via GET /v1/attachment, where the negative price increases the buyer's wallet balance, minting funds to purchase other users' paid attachments.

cwes.name: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input

summary: Frappe CRM before 1.84.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the get_deal_contacts...
description: Frappe CRM before 1.84.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the get_deal_contacts method that allows authenticated low-privileged users to read contacts of deals they cannot access. Attackers can supply or iterate CRM Deal names to obtain linked contacts' full names, email addresses, and mobile numbers, bypassing row-level permission rules.

summary: GitBucket through 4.48.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows...
description: GitBucket through 4.48.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to edit and merge other users' pull requests because the PATCH pulls and PUT pulls merge REST API endpoints only check read access. Attackers can close, reopen, retitle, retarget, or merge pull requests into the base branch without write permission on public repositories or as private-repository guest collaborators.
